legal.privacy_policy_description: Chinnam AAC stores data locally, and the sections below explain each privacy topic in detail.
legal.privacy_policy_paragraph_1: Chinnam AAC collects only the information necessary to operate the app and improve accessibility. We respect your choices and offer transparent controls.
legal.privacy_policy_paragraph_2: All data is stored locally on the device unless you explicitly export it. We do not sell or share personal data with third parties.
legal.privacy_policy_paragraph_3: You can request deletion of your data by resetting the app or deleting stored files from the app settings.
legal.terms_of_service_description: These terms of use outline the responsibilities that keep the app safe, accessible, and reliable for everyone.
legal.terms_of_service_paragraph_1: By using Chinnam AAC, you agree to use the app responsibly, respecting accessibility norms and the safety of others.
legal.terms_of_service_paragraph_2: Content shared through the app must not violate copyright or community standards. We reserve the right to suspend access if policies are abused.
legal.terms_of_service_paragraph_3: We aim to provide a reliable communication tool but do not guarantee uninterrupted service. Updates and maintenance may occur periodically.
